notes: Unit/scale: SEC 10-K tables are presented “in thousands except per share amounts”; all historical dollar amounts were converted to full USD units by multiplying by 1,000. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

Definitions: EBIT = GAAP Operating income; D&A = Depreciation + Amortization of intangibles from the Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows; Capex = “Additions to property, plant and equipment, net”. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

NWC construction (used for historical NWC and for consistency with forecast NWC % of sales): (Accounts receivable + Inventories + Prepaid expenses and other current assets) − (Accounts payable + Accrued liabilities). Cash, short-term investments, income taxes payable, and short-term debt/commercial paper are excluded from this NWC definition. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

Capex expectation anchor: FY26 capex expected at approximately 4% to 6% of FY26 revenue; base case uses ~0.05–0.052 capex % of sales. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

NOL inputs: NOL balance set to federal/state $21.0M expiring in FY2027 plus foreign $131.8M with no expiration ($152.8M total), from the income tax footnote. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

NOL utilization percent is set to null because the 10-K disclosure does not provide a specific utilization rate assumption suitable for a DCF cash taxes schedule. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))
WACC proxy set to 0.095 using StockAnalysis “Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)” for ADI. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/adi/statistics/))
Current price: 309.43 USD as of 2026-03-21 from the market data tool.

catalysts: Sustained bookings/design pipeline leading to revenue growth persistence beyond the initial cyclical recovery. ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))

Execution on operating margin through the mix/cycle and cost discipline, consistent with the near-term outlook for operating margin. ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))

Capital return continuation (dividends and share repurchases) if free cash flow remains strong. ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))
company_overview: Global semiconductor leader bridging the physical and digital worlds with analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing technologies. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

Positioned around the “Intelligent Edge,” with solutions enabling sensing, measurement, connectivity, and edge/AI compute use cases. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

End markets are primarily business-to-business (notably Industrial, Automotive, Communications) with additional Consumer exposure. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))
current_context: Fiscal 2025 revenue was $11.0B (+17% vs. fiscal 2024), with Q4 revenue of $3.08B and growth across end markets. ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))

Fiscal 2025 operating cash flow of $4.8B and free cash flow of $4.3B (44% and 39% of revenue, respectively). ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))

Q1 FY2026 outlook: revenue of $3.1B (+/- $100M) with reported operating margin ~31.0% (+/- 130 bps) at the midpoint. ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes a post-rebound trajectory with mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth fading to low single digits by 2030, while EBIT margin normalizes toward ~28% (target).

Capex intensity set to ~4%–6% of revenue (base-case ~5%), consistent with management’s FY26 capital expenditures expectations. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

Working-capital intensity (NWC as % of sales) mean reverts toward a normalized range after volatility in the last three fiscal years. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

Valuation cross-check uses EV/Sales, EV/EBITDA, and forward P/E from semicap peers as a sanity check on terminal value economics. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/txn/statistics/))
key_risks: Semiconductor cycle reversal (inventory digestion, weaker end-market demand) could pressure both revenue growth and EBIT margin. ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))

Working-capital and capex intensity could deviate from normalization assumptions, impacting free cash flow timing. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

Geopolitical/export restrictions and macro volatility could affect demand and supply-chain execution. ([analog.com](https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/11-25-2025-adi-reports-4th-qtr-fiscal-2025-financial-results.html))

valuation_summary: DCF base case uses historical operating profitability structure (EBIT margin), with D&A and capex expressed as sustainable % of sales anchored to recent realized levels. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6281/000000628125000153/adi-20251101.htm))

Terminal value reflects an exit-multiple approach (exit EV/EBITDA) and a long-run growth rate consistent with mature semiconductor industry economics. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/adi/statistics/))

Comps incorporate forward valuation metrics (EV/Sales, EV/EBITDA, and Forward P/E) for a reasonable range check against the DCF implied multiples. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/txn/statistics/))
